summary: AIGen: Axlung: 70M with h/o NSCLC, left lung; moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, ALK+, PD-L1 20%, cT3N2M1b (bone, bilateral lung, hilar LN mets), recurrent after lobectomy. Prior therapy: 2022 LUL lobectomy (clear margins, pT2bN1M0, no adjuvant), surveillance until 2023 recurrence; current regimen pembrolizumab+carboplatin+paclitaxel since 2024-03-15, with initial partial response and then stable dz, now mild bone progression and grade 2 neuropathy/fatigue. Tumor board question: Disease stability with mild bone progression on current chemo-IO; is therapy switch (ALK inhibitor) indicated? Tumor board decision: Recommend transition to alectinib for ALK+ NSCLC at progression; continue monitoring, manage toxicities, and reassess after next imaging.
